name: Toudou Nazuna
source:
A first-year student at Seiran Girls' Academy.
Rei's cousin, two years his junior. She is a gentle and soft-spoken girl.

Having lived in Kyoto her entire life, she had always wanted to visit Tokyo to broaden her horizons.
She obtained her parents' permission on the condition that Yuno would look after her.

She remembers playing with Rei often when they were young, and she still calls him “Big Brother” and is very attached to him.

She excels at housework, cooking, and cleaning.
She is a somewhat old-fashioned girl who embodies the saying, “Take three steps back to support a man.”
Occasionally, perhaps out of habit, she slips into the speech patterns of a courtesan.

“Ah, Big Brother, please wait a moment. Your tie is crooked, isn’t it?
…There, it’s fixed. Hehe, you’re as wonderful as ever, Big Brother.”
